global: A bowl of shio ramen showcases a clear, golden broth with delicate oil swirls. Thin chashu pork rests atop, surrounded by shredded toppings, all nestled in a white ceramic bowl against a warm, softly lit wooden background.

regions.background: Dark reddish-brown wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and smooth, slightly reflective finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and subtle embossed pattern near base.
regions.soup: Shio ramen broth, golden-yellow, clear with floating oil droplets and thin noodles, gently swirling around a slice of chashu pork.
regions.meat: The chashu pork has a pinkish-white interior with visible marbling, a slightly curled shape, and a glistening, fatty surface.
